description: scripts/security/semgrep-requirements.txt is hash-pinned and NOT managed by Renovate (ignorePaths): regenerate it by hand when SEMGREP_VERSION changes, with pip-compile --generate-hashes (pip-tools) on a requirements.in containing only semgrep==<version>, then review the diff.
security.yml tool versions are bumped by the customManagers below, which only change the version: update GITLEAKS_SHA256 / OSV_SHA256 in the same PR from the release checksums before merging.

customManagers.description: semgrep version in security.yml (hashes file regenerated by hand, see top-level description)
gitleaks version in security.yml (GITLEAKS_SHA256 to update by hand with it)
osv-scanner version in security.yml (OSV_SHA256 to update by hand with it)

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one PR per action, never grouped with libraries (each pin is reviewed on its own)
Batch non-major library updates into one PR to keep the noise down (scanner versions excluded: their sha256 is bumped by hand)
AGP / Kotlin / KSP move together and need care — keep them separate
